# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

The tests pass. The fix adds two lines after the initial regex substitution:

1. `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` — collapses multiple consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen.
2. `text.strip("-")` — removes any leading or trailing hyphens.

This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` instead of `"hello--world-"`, and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"

arguments.summary: Fixed `textkit/slug.py` by adding two post-processing steps after the initial regex substitution: (1) collapse multiple consecutive hyphens into one with `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`, and (2) strip leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`. This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` instead of `"hello--world-"`, and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"`.
